# CG-SRV-002: Server base path changed

A server's base path no longer exists in the candidate, so operation URLs move.

**Why it matters:** Base paths are part of every operation URL.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Servers](./#srv) |
| Detects | `server.basePathChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Base path of server {url} is no longer served by any candidate server.
>
> Every operation URL under this base path moves; consumers using the old base path may fail.
>
> **Fix:** Serve both base paths during a transition, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: /v1 → /v2

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://x/v1'}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://x/v2'}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, high. Base path of server https://x/v1 is no longer served by any candidate server.

### Does not fire: host change only

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://a.x/v1'}, {url: 'https://b.x/v1'}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://b.x/v1'}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Deployments often serve both versions.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-SRV-002
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-SRV-002: { severity: low }
```
